title: Agent-based modeling to assess the effects of time-of-use water tariffs on social equity
abstract: Time-of-use (TOU) tariffs charge higher prices for water used during designated peak periods, encouraging users to shift their water use to off-peak periods. Research in electricity markets has shown that TOU tariffs can have adverse effects on households with low incomes or who lack access to technology, raising equity concerns. This research assesses the differential impact of TOU tariffs on heterogeneous water users using an agent-based modeling (ABM) approach. The ABM is applied to a case study to simulate the response of a community of water users to TOU tariffs and assess the equity impacts of the household cost of water under various scenarios. Findings suggest households with characteristics consistent with disadvantaged groups, including lower incomes, high density, and limited access to technology, may experience an increase in water costs under TOU rates.
abstract_zh: 分时（TOU）水价对指定高峰时段使用的水收取更高的价格，以此鼓励用户将用水转移至非高峰时段。电力市场的研究表明，分时电价可能对低收入家庭或缺乏技术接入的家庭产生不利影响，从而引发公平性问题。本研究采用基于主体的建模（ABM）方法，评估分时水价对异质性用水者的差异化影响。该ABM应用于一个案例研究，模拟一个社区用水者对分时水价的反应，并在多种情景下评估家庭用水成本的公平性影响。研究结果表明，具有弱势群体特征的家庭，包括低收入、高密度居住以及技术接入受限的家庭，在分时水价下可能面临用水成本上升。

title: Defending districts: local levee coordination and the development of the lower Mississippi
Identifying Time-of-Use Demand Characteristics of Residential Water Users for Tailored Demand Management
Left in the Dust: Pecuniary and Environmental Externalities in Water Markets
Dust in the Wind: The Health Costs of Great Salt Lake Desiccation
Waiting to Burn: The National Environmental Policy Act and Fuel Treatments
The Capitalization of Property Rights to Groundwater
abstract: There is limited empirical evidence on the value of formal property rights to natural resources when they are not transferable, and there is regulatory uncertainty about enforcement. This paper takes a hedonic approach to understanding how three core features of groundwater property rights—access, allocation, and seniority—are capitalized into agricultural land values in the High Plains Aquifer region of Kansas. We find that groundwater access rights confer an average land value premium of 71%, or $1445/acre in 2019 dollars. Water rights having larger allocations and more seniority are more highly valued in the land market. The seniority effect is small but is consistent with more junior rights facing greater regulatory risk of curtailment. Taken together, these results suggest that the land market capitalizes constraints to groundwater pumping provided by groundwater property rights. We use our empirical estimates to quantify the distributional costs of modifying existing patterns of pumping, a common challenge of groundwater management organizations seeking to improve the sustainability of extraction.
abstract_zh: 在产权不可转让的情况下，关于自然资源正式产权价值的实证证据十分有限，且执法方面存在监管不确定性。本文采用特征价格（hedonic）方法，考察地下水产权的三个核心特征——取水准入、配额分配和优先序位——如何资本化到堪萨斯州高平原含水层地区农业用地的价值中。我们发现，地下水取水准入权平均带来71%的土地价值溢价，即以2019年美元计每英亩1445美元。配额更大、优先序位更靠前的水权在土地市场上估值更高。优先序位的效应较小，但与优先序位较低的权利面临更大削减监管风险这一解释相一致。综合来看，这些结果表明，土地市场将地下水产权所施加的抽水约束予以资本化。我们利用实证估计，量化了改变现有抽水格局的分配成本，这是地下水管理组织在寻求提高开采可持续性时普遍面临的挑战。

title: Creating American Farmland: Institutional Evolution and the Development of Agricultural Drainage
Water, Dust, and Environmental Justice: The Case of Agricultural Water Diversions
abstract: Water diversions for agriculture reduce ecosystem services provided by saline lakes around the world. Exposed lakebed surfaces are major sources of dust emissions that may exacerbate existing environmental inequities. This paper studies the effects of water diversions and their impacts on particulate pollution arising from reduced inflows to the Salton Sea in California via a spatially explicit particle transport model and changing lakebed exposure. We demonstrate that lakebed dust emissions increased ambient and concentrations and worsened environmental inequalities, with historically disadvantaged communities receiving a disproportionate increase in pollution. Water diversion decisions are often determined by political processes; our findings demonstrate the need for distributional analysis of such decisions to ensure equitable compensation.
abstract_zh: 农业引水减少了世界各地咸水湖所提供的生态系统服务。裸露的湖床表面是尘埃排放的主要来源，可能加剧现有的环境不平等。本文利用空间显式的颗粒物输运模型以及湖床暴露的变化，研究了加利福尼亚州Salton Sea因入湖水量减少而引发的引水效应，以及由此产生的颗粒物污染影响。我们证明，湖床扬尘增加了环境空气中的颗粒物浓度，并加剧了环境不平等，历史上处于不利地位的社区承受了不成比例的污染增幅。引水决策往往由政治过程决定；我们的研究结果表明，有必要对此类决策进行分配性分析，以确保公平的补偿。

title: Dynamic Pricing Framework for Water Demand Management Using Advanced Metering Infrastructure Data
abstract: This research investigates dynamic pricing as a demand management tool to reduce cost and increase the lifespan of water distribution systems by reducing peak hour demand. Individual consumer responses to changes in hourly water price are simulated using advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) data. Demand profiles are used as input to a hydraulic simulation model to evaluate the effects of changing demands on flows and in‐network metrics. The framework is applied to Lakewood City, California, using a model of the pipe network and AMI data collected at nearly 20,000 accounts. Four dynamic pricing policies are applied to the model to show that reductions in morning peak demand ranging from 6% to 25% reduce peak energy demands up to 14%. These small changes in overall energy demand, up to a 1.7% reduction, lead to relatively larger overall reductions in energy cost, up to 5.5%. The results demonstrate the importance of dynamic pricing as a demand‐side strategy for infrastructure management and highlight the potential to accommodate demand growth without additional infrastructure investments.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨动态定价作为需求管理工具的作用，即通过降低高峰时段需求来减少成本并延长供水系统的使用寿命。我们利用高级计量基础设施（AMI）数据，模拟了个体消费者对每小时水价变化的反应。需求曲线作为输入，用于水力模拟模型，以评估需求变化对管网流量及网络内各项指标的影响。该框架应用于加利福尼亚州莱克伍德市，使用该市管网模型以及在近20000个用户账户处采集的AMI数据。对模型施加四种动态定价政策后，结果表明，早高峰需求减少6%至25%，可使高峰能源需求减少多达14%。整体能源需求的这些微小变化（最多减少1.7%），带来了相对更大的能源成本降幅，最多可达5.5%。研究结果表明，动态定价作为基础设施管理的需求侧策略具有重要作用，并凸显了其在无需额外基础设施投资的情况下容纳需求增长的潜力。

title: Manure Nutrient Cycling in U.S. Animal Agriculture Basins – North Carolina Case Study
The Economics of Drought
abstract: Water scarcity and drought have determined the structure, location, and fate of civilizations throughout history. Drought remains an important factor in the performance of developed and developing economies, especially in the agricultural sector. While significant attention has been paid to drought as a meteorological phenomenon and on its economic impact, comparative institutional analysis of the economics of drought is limited. In this review, we focus on how economic institutions, the humanly devised constraints that shape the allocation and use of water, impact the severity and incidence of droughts. Water property rights in developed countries encourage infrastructure investments and reallocations that mitigate drought impacts, although such institutions may codify inequitable water access during drought. Developing economies rely more on informal strategies for mitigating drought and remain more vulnerable, experiencing economic losses, conflict, and violence.
abstract_zh: 水资源稀缺和干旱在历史上决定了文明的结构、位置与命运。干旱在发达经济体和发展中经济体的表现中仍是重要因素，在农业部门尤为如此。尽管干旱作为一种气象现象及其经济影响已受到广泛关注，但对干旱经济学的比较制度分析仍然有限。在本综述中，我们关注经济制度（即塑造水资源配置与使用的人为约束）如何影响干旱的严重程度与发生率。发达国家的水权制度鼓励基础设施投资和水资源再配置，从而减轻干旱影响，但此类制度也可能固化干旱期间不平等的用水机会。发展中经济体更多依赖非正式策略来应对干旱，且仍更为脆弱，会遭受经济损失、冲突和暴力。

title: Paper Water, Wet Water, and the Recognition of Indigenous Property Rights
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Restoring natural resource access for Indigenous groups has become a recent policy focus. We combine satellite data and robust difference-in-difference methods to estimate the causal effect of Native American water right settlements on land and water use on reservations in the western United States over 1974–2012. We find that settlements increase cultivated agricultural land use (crops and hay/pasture) by 8.7%. Our estimates of tribal water use indicate that, even after accounting for water leased off-reservation, many tribes are utilizing only a fraction of their entitlements, forgoing as much as $938 million–$1.8 billion in revenue. We provide evidence suggesting that this gap is driven, in part, by land tenure constraints and a lack of irrigation infrastructure.
abstract_zh: 恢复原住民群体的自然资源获取权已成为近期的政策焦点。我们结合卫星数据与稳健的双重差分方法，估计了美国西部保留地上美洲原住民水权和解对土地与水资源利用的因果效应，时间跨度为1974年至2012年。我们发现，和解使耕地（作物及干草/牧场）面积增加了8.7%。我们对部落用水量的估计表明，即使考虑了保留地外租赁的水量，许多部落所利用的水量仅为其配额的一小部分，由此放弃了高达9.38亿至18亿美元的收入。我们提供的证据表明，这一差距在一定程度上是由土地保有制度的约束以及灌溉基础设施的缺乏所导致的。

title: Property Rights to Land and Agricultural Organization: An Argentina-United States Comparison
abstract: The contributions of Harold Demsetz offer key insights on how property rights and transaction costs shape economic organization. This guides our comparison of agricultural organization in two comparable regions, the Argentine Pampas and the US Midwest. In the US, land was distributed in small parcels and actively traded. In the Pampas, land was distributed in large plots and trade was limited because land was a social and political asset as well as commercial. We analyze why this led to persistently larger farms, specialization in ranching, and peculiar tenancy contracts in Argentina, relative to the US.Our empirical analysis, based on county-level data for both regions, shows that geo-climatic factors cannot explain the observed differences in agricultural organization. We discuss implications for long-term economic development in Argentina.
abstract_zh: 哈罗德·德姆塞茨（Harold Demsetz）的研究为理解产权和交易成本如何塑造经济组织提供了关键见解。这指导了我们对两个条件相近地区（阿根廷潘帕斯草原（Argentine Pampas）和美国中西部）农业组织的比较。在美国，土地被分割为小地块并被积极交易。在潘帕斯草原，土地以大地块的形式分布，交易十分有限，因为土地既是商业资产，也是社会和政治资产。我们分析了为何这导致阿根廷相对于美国形成了规模更大的农场、以畜牧业为主的专业化生产，以及特殊的租佃合同。我们基于两个地区县级数据的实证分析表明，地理气候因素无法解释所观察到的农业组织差异。我们讨论了这些结果对阿根廷长期经济发展的启示。

title: The Impact of Property Rights to Fish on Remote Communities in Alaska
The Economics of Groundwater Governance Institutions Across the Globe
abstract:
This article provides an economic framework for understanding the emergence and purpose of groundwater governance across the globe. We examine ten basins located on six continents
via
an integrated assessment along three dimensions: characteristics of the groundwater resource; externality problems; and governance institutions. Groundwater governance addresses local externalities to balance the benefits of reducing common pool losses with the costs of doing so. While broad, basin‐wide solutions to open access pumping are limited, spatially localized externality problems raise the benefits of management actions, allowing for the implementation of more stringent pumping controls in certain areas.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了一个经济学框架，用以理解全球各地地下水治理的出现及其目的。我们通过综合评估，考察了分布于六大洲的十个流域，分析维度包括：地下水资源特征、外部性问题以及治理制度。地下水治理针对局部外部性问题，以平衡减少公共池塘损失的收益与为此付出的成本。尽管针对开放获取式抽水的大范围、流域级解决方案十分有限，但空间上局部化的外部性问题提高了管理行动的收益，从而允许在某些地区实施更为严格的抽水控制。

title: Water Storage and Agricultural Resilience to Drought: Historical Evidence of the Capacity and Institutional Limits in the United States
abstract: Food systems are particularly sensitive to changing precipitation patterns. Resilience via irrigation will depend on baseline conditions, water source, and institutional constraints which have not been studied jointly. We draw on over 100 years of agricultural production and weather data across the United States to identify the extent to which access to stored water—distinguished by its source and location—affects drought resiliency. Arid regions with access to stored water avoided the 13% losses in crop value experienced in irrigated areas with more limited storage during droughts. Humid regions are also beginning to adopt irrigation, but with less aggregate impact during drought. The incomplete governance of groundwater withdrawals in many areas allow resiliency in the near-term, but potentially at the expense of future water availability. Conversely, surface water rights allow for the widespread application of irrigation water, but with less resiliency during significant periods of drought.
abstract_zh: 粮食系统对降水模式的变化尤为敏感。通过灌溉实现的抗灾能力将取决于基础条件、水源以及制度约束，而这些因素此前尚未被联合研究。我们利用美国100多年的农业生产和气象数据，考察获取蓄水（按其来源和位置区分）在多大程度上影响干旱抵御能力。干旱期间，能够获取蓄水的干旱地区避免了灌溉区域因蓄水能力有限而遭受的13%作物价值损失。湿润地区也开始采用灌溉，但在干旱期间的总体影响较小。在许多地区，地下水取水治理的不完善使其在短期内具有抵御能力，但可能以损害未来水资源供应为代价。相反，地表水水权使灌溉水得以广泛应用，但在严重干旱时期的抵御能力较弱。

title: Contracting and the Commons: Linking the Insight of Gary Libecap and Elinor Ostrom
venue: The Environmental Optimism of Elinor Ostrom (Center for Growth and Opportunity)

title: Irrigation Investment on an American Indian Reservation
abstract: American Indian reservations have low incomes and high rates of poverty relative to adjacent communities, and the income gap appears to be even larger for Indian farmers. We examine the extent to which a lack of access to capital might explain these differences using irrigation systems as a proxy for on‐farm investment around the Uintah‐Ouray Indian Reservation in eastern Utah. Uintah land is held in trust by the US government, and farmers on this land face significant barriers to acquiring capital to invest in irrigation equipment and infrastructure. We use the boundaries from a 1905 land allotment as a natural experiment, employing both sharp and fuzzy regression discontinuity designs to explore whether agricultural land use, irrigation levels, irrigation investment, and crop choice differ across the boundary. The original allocation provided similar land in the immediate neighborhood around its borders, and our results suggest that today tribal trust land is farmed and irrigated at rates similar to adjacent land. However, conditional on being irrigated, tribal trust land is around thirty‐two percentage points less likely to utilize capital‐intensive sprinkler irrigation, and up to ten percentage points less likely to grow high‐value crops. Trust ownership, which is characterized by cumbersome bureaucratic processes, limits on agricultural lease flexibility, and the inability to use land as collateral to acquire loans, is a likely explanation for the observed differences.
abstract_zh: 美国印第安保留地的收入较低，贫困率相对于邻近社区较高，而印第安农民之间的收入差距似乎更大。我们以犹他州东部尤因塔-乌雷（Uintah-Ouray）印第安保留地周边的灌溉系统作为农场投资的代理指标，考察缺乏资本获取渠道能否解释这些差异。尤因塔土地由美国政府以信托形式持有，这些土地上的农民在获取资本以投资灌溉设备和基础设施方面面临重大障碍。我们利用1905年土地分配的边界作为自然实验，采用清晰与模糊断点回归设计，考察农业用地利用、灌溉水平、灌溉投资和作物选择在边界两侧是否存在差异。最初的分配在边界附近提供了相似的土地，我们的结果表明，如今部落信托土地的耕种和灌溉比例与邻近土地相似。然而，在已灌溉的前提下，部落信托土地使用资本密集型喷灌的可能性低约32个百分点，种植高价值作物的可能性最多低10个百分点。信托所有权具有繁琐的官僚程序、对农业租赁灵活性的限制，以及无法以土地作为抵押获取贷款等特点，这很可能是造成上述差异的原因。

title: Predator-Prey Interaction in a Bi-Resource Economy and the Role of Free Trade
The Economics of Indigenous Water Claim Settlements in the American West
abstract: The American West confronts the challenge of fulfilling indigenous claims to water within the context of increasingly scarce and variable water supplies. 170 of 226 American Indian reservations have unresolved water claims that potentially exceed the region’s hydrological capacity, generating uncertainty for tribes and off-reservation water users. To help resolve key uncertainties about dispute origins and outcomes, we construct a complete and novel dataset on Indian water settlements and reservation characteristics which we then analyze using a bargaining framework from economics. We find that rapid off-reservation population growth, water scarcity, and large anticipated water entitlements catalyze disputes. When more users are involved in the negotiations, transaction costs delay settlement, increasing water insecurity. We use our findings to predict allocations for 25 ongoing water right negotiations. These estimates help bound the uncertainty facing water managers throughout the American West.
abstract_zh: 美国西部面临着在水供应日益稀缺且多变的背景下满足原住民水权主张的挑战。226个美洲印第安保留地中有170个存在尚未解决的水权主张，这些主张可能超出该地区的水文承载能力，给部落和保留地外的用水者带来不确定性。为帮助解决纠纷起因和结果方面的关键不确定性，我们构建了一个关于印第安水资源和解及保留地特征的完整新数据集，并运用经济学中的讨价还价框架进行分析。我们发现，保留地外人口的快速增长、水资源稀缺以及预期的大量水权配额会引发纠纷。当更多用水者参与谈判时，交易成本会延迟和解，从而加剧水资源不安全。我们利用研究结果预测了25项正在进行中的水权谈判的分配结果。这些估计有助于界定美国西部水资源管理者所面临的不确定性范围。

title: The Cost of Addressing Saline Lake Decline and the Potential for Water Conservation Markets
An illiquid market in the desert: Estimating the cost of water trade restrictions in northern Chile
abstract: This paper estimates the cost of a policy to restrict water trades to mining firms in northern Chile to protect riparian ecosystems and indigenous agriculture. In response to the policy, mining firms have developed high-cost desalination and pumping facilities to secure adequate water supplies. We develop a methodology and estimate the cost of market transactions that fail to occur due to the policy. Lost trade surplus is estimated at $52 million per year. Without trade restrictions, around 86% of the remaining agricultural water in the region would be transferred to mining.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了一项限制向智利北部采矿企业转让水权的政策的成本，该政策旨在保护河岸生态系统和原住民农业。为应对该政策，采矿企业已建设了高成本的海水淡化和抽水设施，以确保充足的水源供应。我们开发了一种方法，并估计了因政策而未能发生的市场交易的成本。损失的贸易剩余估计为每年5200万美元。若不实施贸易限制，该地区约86%的剩余农业用水将转让给采矿业。

title: How Transaction Costs Obstruct Collective Action: Evidence from California's Groundwater
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Collective action to remedy the losses of open access to common-pool resources often is late and incomplete, extending rent dissipation. Examples include persistent over-exploitation of oil fields and ocean fisheries, despite general agreement that production constraints are needed. Transaction costs encountered in assigning property rights are an explanation, but analysis of their role is limited by a lack of systematic data. We examine governance institutions in California's 445 groundwater basins using a new dataset to identify factors that influence the adoption of extraction controls. In 309 basins, institutions allow unconstrained pumping, while an additional 105 basins have weak management plans. Twenty of these basins are severely overdrafted. Meanwhile, users in 31 basins have defined groundwater property rights, the most complete solution. We document the critical role of transaction costs in explaining this variation in responses. This research adds to the literatures on open access, transaction costs, bargaining, and property rights
abstract_zh: 为补救开放获取式公共池塘资源所造成的损失，集体行动往往迟缓且不完整，从而延长了租金耗散。例如，尽管人们普遍认同需要限制产量，油田和海洋渔业的过度开发仍长期存在。在界定产权时发生的交易成本是一种解释，但由于缺乏系统性数据，对其作用的分析十分有限。我们利用一个新数据集，考察了加利福尼亚州445个地下水盆地的治理制度，以识别影响采取开采控制措施的因素。在309个盆地中，制度允许不受限制的抽水；另有105个盆地的管理计划较为薄弱，其中20个盆地严重超采。与此同时，31个盆地的用户已界定了地下水产权，这是最为完善的解决方案。我们记录了交易成本在解释这种反应差异中的关键作用。本研究丰富了关于开放获取、交易成本、讨价还价和产权的文献。

title: The Role of Irrigation in the Development of Agriculture in the United States
abstract: We examine the role of irrigation in explaining U.S. agricultural gains post-1940. Specifically, we analyze how productivity and farm values changed in the western United States as a result of technological and policy changes that expanded access to ground and surface water. To statistically identify the effects, we compare counties based on their potential access to irrigation water defined by physical characteristics. We find areas with access to large streams and/or groundwater increase crop production relative to areas with only small streams by $19 billion annually, equivalent to 90 percent of the total annual increase in the western United States after 1940.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了灌溉在解释1940年后美国农业增长中的作用。具体而言，我们分析了美国西部地区因技术和政策变化而扩大地下水和地表水获取途径后，其农业生产率和农场价值的变化。为在统计上识别这些效应，我们依据由自然地理特征界定的潜在灌溉水获取条件对各县进行比较。我们发现，相较于仅有小型溪流的地区，能够获取大型河流和/或地下水的地区，其作物产量每年增加190亿美元，相当于1940年后美国西部每年总增长量的90%。

title: Economic Insight from Utah's Water Efficiency Supply Curve
abstract: Across the western US, growing populations and urbanization along with environmental demands and a changing climate have strained water allocation mechanisms originally designed to provide water to agriculture. This paper provides a methodology, using Utah as an example, for examining the options for new water supply via conservation, interpretable by policymakers, water agencies, and water users. Findings indicate that the largest potential water savings, at the lowest cost, are in agriculture and outdoor residential water use, where more efficient applications can maintain the acreage of crops and lawns at current levels while dramatically reducing use.
abstract_zh: 在美国西部各地，人口增长与城市化，加上环境需求和气候变化，已使最初为农业供水而设计的水资源配置机制承受压力。本文以犹他州为例，提出了一种方法，用以考察通过节约用水获取新增供水的各种选择，该方法可供政策制定者、水务机构和用水者理解。研究结果表明，最大的潜在节水量且成本最低的领域在于农业和户外住宅用水：更高效的用水方式能够在维持现有作物和草坪面积不变的同时，大幅减少用水量。

title: What Lies Beneath? Aquifer Heterogeneity and the Economics of Groundwater Management
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: This paper examines the distribution of economic benefits from groundwater management as a consequence of underlying aquifer characteristics. The portions of an aquifer where water moves rapidly, those with high hydraulic conductivity, as well as those that receive less yearly recharge, face a more costly common-pool problem and therefore receive higher benefits from management. The introduction of management districts in Kansas is used to test the effect of underlying aquifer characteristics on changes in agricultural land value, farm size, and crop choice. A landowner in a county with hydraulic conductivity one standard deviation higher sees a relative land value increase of 5%–8% when management is implemented. Counties with lower recharge also see relative increases in land value. Changes in farm size and percentage of cropland in corn are also consistent with the proposition that the effect of management is unequal and depends on properties of the physical system.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了地下含水层特征如何导致地下水管理的经济效益分布不均。含水层中水流迅速的部分（即水力传导系数较高的区域），以及年补给量较少的区域，面临着成本更高的公共池塘问题，因而从管理中获得的收益也更高。堪萨斯州管理区的设立被用于检验含水层基础特征对农业用地价值、农场规模和作物选择变化的影响。水力传导系数每高出一个标准差的县，在实施管理后其土地相对价值增长5%至8%。补给量较低的县，其土地相对价值也有所增长。农场规模的变化以及玉米在耕地中所占比例的变化，同样与以下命题相一致：管理的效果是不均衡的，并取决于物理系统的特性。

title: Water Institutions and the Law of One price
venue: Handbook on the Economics of Natural Resource
abstract: The topics discussed in the Handbook on the Economics of Natural Resources are essential for those looking to understand how best to use and conserve the resources that form the foundation for human well-being. These include nonrenewable resources, modeling of biological resources, conservation of biological resources and water resources. The expert contributors of this Handbook provide solutions to many of the problems that growing populations now face, and sketch the likely future developments in the field of natural resource economics whilst paving the way for new thinking.
abstract_zh: 《自然资源经济学手册》（Handbook on the Economics of Natural Resources）所讨论的主题，对于希望理解如何最好地利用和保护构成人类福祉基础的资源的人而言至关重要。这些主题包括不可再生资源、生物资源建模、生物资源保护以及水资源。本手册的专家撰稿人针对日益增长的人口所面临的诸多问题提供了解决方案，并勾勒了自然资源经济学领域未来可能的发展方向，为新的思考铺平了道路。

title: Comparative Assessment of Water Markets: Insights from the Murray-Darling Basin of Australia and the Western USA
